text_post: Hey guys, this my first FR in a long time.  A little info, its Olympics fever here in Vancouver, so the opportunity to game is stronger than ever! I decided to go meet up with two of my buddies at my uni to predrink before we hit up downtown to go clubbing. I meet my one friend and go to the liquor store. We walk in, and there's this HB9 promo girl right at the entrance giving samples of some beer. Anyways, as we enter, I was in mid discussion with my friend so we basically completely ignored her and went to make our choice of drink for the night. Turns out my buddy knows the entire staff in the store cuz he used to work there, so we're chatting with everyone, he goes in the back to talk with some of his buddies while i decide which gin we're gonna drink... during this time i notice the HB9 is observing me, I ask one of the guys working there which brand of gin he thinks is better (bombay or tanqueray?) and I make some small little joke which gained a few chuckles and to my surprise the HB9 who obviously was listening in had laughed. Anyways... I make my choice, find my buddy pay and as we're leaving she smiles at me and says "have a good night!" or something along those lines, i smile back and say you too... Now, as we're starting to head back to his place, we run into 2 of my friends who need a little "help" purchasing some liquor... i figure perfect, i can chatup the promo girl this time. So I walk into the liquor store, say "hi again and smile" and as im walking by, i kind of shoulder turn and look at her and ask what shes giving samples of. She explains blah blah, gives me a sample...  Me: So do you work for (beer brand)? HB9: No I work for a promotion company, and they currently have me working here for this particular brand. Me: Ahh okay, well I was actually going to ask you, my friend that I was in here just a few minutes ago, well we're throwing a large Yacht party at the end of next month (this is true, so its not like its some fake DHV that I can't back up lol) and we're actually looking for some promo girls to help with the party...  HB9: Oh well I know the manager of the promo company i work for, but here actually call me (she wrote her name and number down on a piece of paper and handed to me) Me: Thanks... Hb9... my name is Adam, pleasure to meet you.  Hb9: Nice meeting you. Me: When i get more info on the party, ill give you a call or shoot you a txt. HB9: Yea that would be great! (she seemed really excited and enthusiastic about it) Anyways, I purchase the rest of the liquor and say bye as i walk out.  There was a bit more fluff talk and what not but that was the gist of the convo and it went really smooth, she definitely was giving ioi's and she easily could of gave me the name of the company she works for instead of giving me her #. My question, should i only contact her after me and my friend have the date and yacht booked and try and setup a meeting to "discuss promo stuff" or what can be done in this situation. Needless to say, this really boosted my confidence up through the roof for the rest of the night. After a little ibt of predrinking, me and 2 buddies hit the streets and got to a club, unfortunately we got there a bit late and thus had to wait about 2hrs in line... definitely a mood killer. Regardless, once inside, bought a drink, and immediately spotted a 2 set of girls kind of dancing boringly by themselves inside their VIP lounge section. I immediately lead my friends towards that are and there are seats just infront of the vip lounge over a barricade... im sitting with my 2 buddies with our backs to the girls. I then open one of the girls over my shoulder Me: So why are you and your friend secluded in this little area? Hb8: Well, only special people get to be here. Me: Well, im a very special person, and I'm not sitting in that section... so something doesn't add up... HB8: laughs, gives some ioi's...  Me: i introduce myself, get her name, all the while she shook my hand but i held onto it, and kind of pulled her closer to myself to whisper in her ear (compliance test, and she definitely showed no resistance) i tell her it would be best if my friends and I were to join her and her friends in the booth to see if they're really that special  . Hb8: Come right ahead  so my 2 buddies and i walk in, i lead the way, her friend that was beside her is hb9 and i introduce myself to her confidently, comment on her name (was a really pretty name) anyways, we talk for a bit, i tried talking to 2 other hb8's and 9's that were there in the booth as well, one of which was giving this bitchy vibe so i quickly decided to go back to the original 2 set. Anyways, about 3 min in, all of a sudden all of them were leaving (it was 1:50am at this time)  so before anything could happen they were getting up to leave cuz they had to go... anyways, first HB8 that i originally opened gives me a hug and says bye, and then surprisingly HB9 that i commented on her name, gives me a big hug and kiss on the cheek and says sorry they cant stay but their rides are here... I was kind of disappointed i didn't try to # close or anything, but it was technically my warmup set, a very decent warmup set. Anyways... with the girls gone, the bouncer said we cant use the booth because its the owners booth or some lame excuse like that. We move onto the dance floor, i find another section with an identical vip lounge section, this time theres just a bunch of dudes standing around. Well, i decide that i can befriend them and have access to the booth. I go up to one of the guys thats just standing around Me: Hey, whats going on man... why are u and ur buddies just standing around Him: Nah man, we're just chillin for now Me: You need to be getting girls bro! look you got this booth but you're letting it go to waste! him: We had girls earlier, they just left... me: Then you gotta get out there and get some more! and before i could even say anything else, he took his drink slammed it back, slammed against the table and said "YOU'RE FUCKING RIGHT!!" and stormed almost ran and disappeared into the dance floor... not exactly how i planned lol, so i talked up another one of the guys, befriended him and he basically offered us the booth, which after about 20mins was strictly mine and my friends. Anyways, some hb7 came into our lounge, my 2 buddies were occupied with some other girls... i start chatting her up, she said shes going to some uni, i mention what she should check out there, she starts giving iois, i do a little bit of negging etc... then her guy friend comes by and tells me "shes with me, shes taken"... i say no worries, i was only telling her about blah blah blah... he leaves, and she tells me hes not her bf just a protective friend...we continue talking (she did say after him tho that she does indeed have a bf, but i just plowed right through)... i brought out the yacht thing from earlier, # closed and went to game some other chicks. I number closed a few more girls, some i used the yacht thing some i didnt... nothing really to particular Then, after clubbing my buddies and i went to subway, as they went to order i noticed a really cute hb8.5 so i sat down at the table beside her... i initiate some sort of convo and we literally talk for about 20min as my buddies are waiting for their food... we had a lot of stuff in common, things were going great... all of a sudden her friend hb9 comes a long and basically has this bitchy attitude and grabs her friend and pulls her away... it was so sudden, and the hb8.5 goes, sorry i gtg, but give me your number... so i gave her my number and she says "thanks, it was nice talking to you ADAM" emphasizing that she remembered my name. it turns out my friend had gotten the hb9's full name and #...he used the yacht story...  I however, doubt that ill get a call from hb8.5 although out of all the girls, id probably want to see her the most. Anyway, sorry if the writing is confusing/rant like, but im just doing a mind dump from what happened so i can have it for record:) Comment/critique thanks:D
